clusters.summary: Looks like a good bunch of speculation in there but no bad news to be found. Just as good but cheaper? Sign me up. For this model, I mean. And not the Anthropic IPO. Fun analysis. I guess it’s not surprising to see the need for speed™ as an important factor, but who is using Fable for run of the mill coding work? It’s too pricey! I guess what I really want to know is how Gemini 4 Neon w/Antigravity compares with Opus 5.5/Claude Code. I'm not really into using LLMs in a particularly advanced way, I just use CC like 99% of the time when I need to write something, and then maybe Codex to second guess it. But...

clusters.summary:
Carbon is $2 now, $4 in 2 weeks. Argon is $2 now, $4 in 2 weeks.
Neon is $3. Can someone at Google explain why there are 3 models at such similar price points. 3 different models per lab was already confusing, 4 is really confusing. Very hard to figure out in what situation I would use Carbon, Argon, Neon or Hydrogen if I'm coming in brand new to Google AI. I just got access to it in chat.
They seemed to have taken out argon.
